title: Google Ads for Local Businesses: 2026 Guide

facts.fact: Savoir Management recommends a targeting radius of 5 to 15 miles for shops and clinics, and a wider radius for mobile services.
facts.quote: Use a radius of 5 to 15 miles for shops and clinics, wider for mobile services.

facts.fact: Savoir Management suggests starting local Google Ads at $15 to $50 per day focused on the top two or three services.
facts.quote: Start with $15 to $50 per day focused on your top two or three services

facts.fact: In Savoir Management's example budget formula, the assumed average job value is $400.
In Savoir Management's example budget formula, the target cost per customer is $80.
In Savoir Management's example budget formula, the assumed close rate on calls is 40%.
facts.quote: Close rate on calls: 40%, so a target cost per call of $32

facts.fact: In Savoir Management's example, a daily budget for about three calls a day is roughly $100, or start at $50 and grow.
facts.quote: Daily budget for about three calls a day: roughly $100, or start at $50 and grow

facts.fact: Savoir Management states that Local Services Ads charge per lead instead of per click.
facts.quote: charge per lead instead of per click and appear above regular search ads

facts.fact: The Savoir Management article was published on 2026-09-19.

The page lists targeting too wide an area, bidding on generic national keywords, sending clicks to a homepage, ignoring calls as conversions, and running ads when nobody answers as the common pitfalls that drain local advertising budgets.
facts.quote: The common pitfalls are targeting too wide an area, bidding on generic national keywords, sending clicks to a homepage, ignoring calls as conversions and running ads when nobody answers.

facts.fact: The page advises looking at last year's calls and bookings by month and planning budgets around those seasonal patterns instead of spending evenly all year.
facts.quote: Look at last year's calls and bookings by month, then plan budgets around those patterns instead of spending evenly all year.

facts.fact: The page says that using the "presence or interest" targeting setting lets people outside the advertiser's area see ads, and lists it as a pitfall.
facts.quote: Using "presence or interest" so people outside your area see ads

facts.fact: The page lists having no call tracking as a common pitfall for local advertisers.
The page recommends reviewing search terms each season because people describe their needs differently, for example with "emergency" searches rising when something breaks.
facts.quote: Review search terms each season, because people describe their needs differently

facts.fact: The page suggests running campaigns for maintenance plans, gift cards or advance booking discounts during slow months to keep the calendar fuller.
facts.quote: During slow months, campaigns for maintenance plans, gift cards or advance booking discounts can keep the calendar fuller.

facts.fact: The page recommends combining tight targeting, local keywords, strong assets, an accurate Business Profile and a fast local landing page, then improving weekly.
facts.quote: Combine tight targeting, local keywords, strong assets, an accurate Business Profile and a fast local landing page, then improve weekly.
